packages.name: Independent Living
packages.tagline: Low risk — light coordination, annual assessment, optional wearable SOS
packages.description: Includes the Kushalaya assessment pathway, family dashboard access, and light care coordination. Optional Wearable Care Alert Kit (SOS to the family portal) when the home calls for it. Recommended safety improvements are quoted as complete installations (product + professional labor). Best when KushAlaya Safety Score is Excellent/Good. Hyderabad: ₹1,000–₹1,500/mo · ₹12,000–₹18,000/yr.

packages.name: Assisted Living at Home
packages.tagline: Moderate risk — wellness, care coordination, wearable SOS & immobility alerts
packages.description: Assessment, bathroom/entry safety plan, scheduled wellness coordination, and Care Manager support. Includes a path to the Wearable Care Alert Kit — SOS button alerts, daytime immobility warnings, and experimental possible-fall alerts to the family portal. Home modifications and equipment are quoted as turnkey installations — materials and labor together — after the assessment. Hyderabad: ₹3,000–₹5,000/mo · ₹36,000–₹60,000/yr.

packages.name: Premium Care
packages.tagline: High support — wearable alerts, smart home, PT path, Care Manager
packages.description: Full safety program coordination with Wearable Care Alert Kit (SOS, immobility, experimental possible-fall), smart monitoring setup path, physiotherapy and companion visit coordination, and elevated Care Manager involvement. Approved products and installs are presented as complete installed prices (hardware + labor), coordinated under Kushalaya standards. Hyderabad: ₹8,000–₹15,000/mo · ₹96,000–₹180,000/yr.

packages.name: NRI Family Peace of Mind
packages.tagline: Remote family — wearable SOS, portal alerts, dedicated ECM
packages.description: Dedicated Elder Care Manager, visit photos, family portal updates, and Wearable Care Alert Kit alerts (SOS, immobility, experimental possible-fall) for families abroad. When the home needs changes, you receive clear installed quotes (product + labor) with photos and completion notes. Hyderabad: ₹12,000–₹25,000/mo · ₹144,000–₹300,000/yr.
